description: Mister Smith Framework — Phase 10 autonomy observability scaffold. All PromQL queries are placeholders that MS-33 must wire to typed AutonomyStatusView state.

panels.description: Placeholder gauge for operator-visible workflow state derived from AutonomyStatusView.graph.
panels.title: Active Autonomy Workflows

panels.description: Placeholder branch-health summary from AutonomyStatusView.branches. Assumes one gauge per branch with a state label.
panels.title: Degraded Branches

panels.description: Placeholder checkpoint freshness gauge from branch checkpoint lineage. MS-33 must emit seconds since the last durable checkpoint.
panels.title: Max Checkpoint Age

panels.description: Placeholder memory-pressure ratio from AutonomyStatusView.memory_pressure. Assumes a normalized 0..1 pressure ratio.
panels.title: Max Context Pressure

panels.description: Placeholder topology selection table from AutonomyStatusView.topology. Prefer stable rationale codes over free-form labels if label cardinality becomes unsafe.
panels.title: Current Topology Selection

panels.description: Placeholder branch-state visibility for operator inspection. Assumes one active series per workflow and state.
panels.title: Branch State by Workflow

panels.description: Placeholder checkpoint lineage panel. MS-33 should back this with per-branch checkpoint age or freshness metrics derived from typed state.
panels.title: Checkpoint Freshness by Branch

panels.description: Placeholder context-pressure panel. Assumes the runtime exports a normalized pressure ratio and a coarse pressure_level label.
panels.title: Context Pressure by Branch

panels.description: Placeholder intervention history from AutonomyStatusView.interventions. Assumes a counter labeled by intervention type and decision source.
panels.title: Interventions by Type (15m)

panels.description: Placeholder delegation and provenance visibility from AutonomyStatusView.delegation_alerts. Intended for invalid, expired, revoked, or otherwise rejected chains only.
panels.title: Provenance Rejections by Reason (15m)

title: Mister Smith Autonomy
